items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: But Billy was with us on one of the -- And it could've been this one, because he was on the first one with us. I mean, at the Atlantic Club.

ctx.x: And on the other two, you were accompanied by a trumpet player. And I think we discussed this off tape the last time we were talking. We couldn't remember which one of the two it was. Whether it was Billy Butterfield or Yank Lawson.

You know, I really have to hear the record to tell whether it was Yank or Billy Butterfield. But Billy was with us on one of the -- And it could've been this one, because he was on the first one with us. I mean, at the Atlantic Club.
